name: Australian National Bibliographic Database
AI Notes 2: Part of Trove. National bibliographic database. API available via Trove v3.

name: TROVE
AI Notes 2: Trove is the National Library of Australia's discovery platform. Includes newspapers, books, images, maps, music, archives, and websites. API v3 available.

name: Atlas of Living Australia
AI Notes 2: National biodiversity database. Aggregates Australian biodiversity data. Provides REST APIs (JSON, XML, CSV, WMS).

name: Australian National University Library
AI Notes 2: Collection: over 1.5 million books, 62 km of shelving. Z39.50 via ANU Library.

name: Australian National University Library
AI Notes 2: Archives component of ANU Library. Holds 269,727 archival-manuscript items (from CSV). No separate API identified.

name: National Library of Australia
AI Notes 2: Collection: ~10 million items. Trove provides API access.

name: Australian Bureau of Statistics
AI Notes 2: Provides SDMX API, Data API, Indicator API, Time Series Directory API.

name: Australian Museum
AI Notes 2: Collection: >22 million objects. No public API identified (data accessible via Atlas of Living Australia).

name: Research Data Australia
AI Notes 2: ARDC metadata registry. Provides REST APIs for accessing research data descriptions.

name: Parliament of Australia
AI Notes 2: Parliamentary information system. Provides access to Hansard, bills, committees, etc. API access via OpenAustralia.org and other third-party tools. No official public API documented.

name: AustLII Australasian Legal Information Institute
AI Notes 2: Free online database of Australian legal information. Provides SINO CGI API for searching case law and legislation.

name: University of Sydney Library
AI Notes 2: Largest academic library in Southern Hemisphere. Collection: 5.1 million print items, 70,000 e-journals. Z39.50 via Fisher Library.

name: University of New South Wales Library
AI Notes 2: Collection: 2 million books. Z39.50 via UNSW Library.

name: State Library Victoria
AI Notes 2: Collection: over 4.5 million items. Over 2 million books. No public Z39.50/API found.

name: Queensland State Archives
AI Notes 2: Collection: 3.5+ million records, 70 linear km. No API found.

name: Australian intellectual property (IP)
AI Notes 2: IP Australia APIs for patents, trademarks, designs. REST APIs via MuleSoft. Data feed available.

name: National Film and Sound Archive of Australia
AI Notes 2: Collection: 4+ million items. No public API identified.

name: NSW State Archives Collection
AI Notes 2: Collection: 14+ million items, 89 linear km. No public API identified.
